We're hiring: Site Reliability Engineer

Brindle Labs (a fictional company) is looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to join our platform team in Bengaluru. This is a hybrid role with two office days per week.

Responsibilities

  • Run and improve our Kubernetes clusters across two cloud regions.
  • Own incident response tooling and lead blameless post-incident reviews.
  • Automate infrastructure with Terraform.

You should have

  • 3+ years operating production Linux systems.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Terraform.
  • Proficiency in Go or Python.

Bonus: experience with Prometheus and Grafana.
